title: GTA 6 Map Leak Reveals Size of Rockstar's New Vice City
description: A recent Polygon report highlights an apparent GTA 6 map leak of Leonida that matches previous teases from Rockstar's GTA Online.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Map Leak Sheds Light on the Scale of Rockstar's New Vice City

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6, details surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world epic continue to circulate across the internet. In a recent report by Polygon, attention has been drawn to an apparent GTA 6 map leak showcasing the scale of the game's setting in Leonida.

According to the media outlet, this newly surfaced map layout and size remarkably match recent teases and hints previously dropped directly by Rockstar within Grand Theft Auto Online. This surprising alignment between community-facing leaks and official in-game easter eggs has intensified discussions among fans who are constantly analyzing every piece of promotional material and update provided by the developer.

### Connecting the Dots: Online Teases and Map Leaks

Rockstar Games has a long-standing tradition of hinting at its future projects through existing titles. Over the past few years, various updates within GTA Online have featured subtle clues, artwork, and environmental storytelling pointing toward a modernized rendition of Vice City and its surrounding areas. Polygon's coverage bridges the gap between these subtle developer hints and the newly leaked map details, suggesting a cohesive vision for the state of Leonida.

While the industry must always approach unconfirmed leaks with a degree of caution, the correlation between the leaked scale and Rockstar's own online teases adds a layer of credibility that is hard to ignore. If the proportions and regional divisions indicated in the leak prove accurate, players are looking at an expansive, highly detailed playground that far surpasses previous franchise entries in scope.

### What This Means for the Future of Vice City

Vice City holds a legendary status in gaming history, and expanding it into the modern state of Leonida represents a monumental undertaking for Rockstar. The combination of dense urban environments, sprawling rural landscapes, and coastal regions is expected to push the boundaries of current hardware capabilities and open-world design philosophies.

### Editor's Take

Polygon's report offers an exciting glimpse into the puzzle that is GTA 6 development. While official confirmation from Rockstar remains the ultimate benchmark, the matching pieces between the leaked Leonida map and GTA Online teases are genuinely fascinating. It highlights Rockstar's clever marketing and world-building strategy, keeping the anticipation at an all-time high as we await further official revelations.
